title: Liverpool parade attack: victims describe horror of day as driver due to be sentenced – live
summary: Victim impact statements read at sentencing hearing of Paul Doyle, who pleaded guilty to 31 offences As a reminder, on Monday, prosecutors said in the space of two minutes, Doyle’s Ford Galaxy – which weighed nearly two tonnes – collided with “well over 100 people” and he was “prepared to cause those in the crowd, even children, serious harm if necessary to achieve his aim of getting through”. Doyle admitted to dangerous driving, affray, 17 charges of attempting to cause grievous bodily harm (GBH) with intent, nine counts of causing GBH with intent and three counts of wounding with intent last month.
